historical_run.model: Text to Image with gpt-image-2 at 1:1; Image to 3D from the image's task ID with model_type standard (meshy-7.1 geometry), texture_model meshy-7, enable_pbr true, texture_resolution 4k and target_formats glb. Neither task response includes a model field; the settings are the ones the agent sent.
historical_run.note: The pictured run sent the README's Step 1 prompt, with one added sentence asking for a project-only skills install, and its Step 4 prompt to Claude Code (claude -p, model claude-opus-5-5) in a new Unreal Engine 5.8.2 Third Person project on macOS on November 9, 2026, with Unreal MCP and All Toolsets enabled and Auto Start Server on, signed in to the Meshy CLI 0.8.5 through the browser with no API key. The agent could not price the image from the CLI's dry run and quoted 9 credits from Meshy's pricing page once it was allowed to fetch it. Text-to-image task 01a1c230-7292-709b-9012-160c5ff2bae9: 9 credits, 27.4 s from creation to finish; about 55 s from the approval to the agent showing the image, which it downloaded to its own scratch folder and checked against the prompt. The Step 4 prompt then didn't name the 3D models, and the agent proposed meshy-t2 with meshy-n1 (15 credits, about 10,000 triangles, 2K base color, no PBR maps); it was told to use meshy-7.1 with meshy-7 PBR textures at 4K, which the published prompt now names. Image-to-3d task 01a1c232-0100-7440-b5b6-d9a33a38ec97: 30 credits, 74.7 s from creation to finish, 105 s from the approval to MeshyAssets/charging-dock.glb on disk. StaticMeshTools.import_file refused the GLB (its FBX importer reads only fbx and obj); the agent created /Game/Meshy/ChargingDock and opened it in the Content Browser, and the GLB was imported with Interchange's default options from the editor's Python API in place of the drag-and-drop: one static mesh, one material instance and three textures, Approx Size 140 x 190 x 110 cm, Nanite on, one convex collision primitive. The agent traced the floor, found that three meters out the 1.9 m base would straddle the 10 cm step at the edge of the PlayerStart's platform, placed the dock 2.3 m out on the platform, turned it 90 degrees so the pad faces the PlayerStart, and set its base on the floor. In Play In Editor the character's capsule was blocked by the dock. A second run the same day used the Meshy CLI 0.8.5 directly with the Step 3 prompt: text-to-image task 01a1c22a-92b9-77ad-9a60-7baf4cd61c54, 9 credits, 28.8 s (34 s for the command); image-to-3d task 01a1c22b-721a-74fa-9807-bda7c1765acb, 30 credits, 66.1 s (86 s for the command), 354,382 triangles in a 33,850,288-byte GLB measuring 1.614 x 1.143 x 1.903 m. Before it, one image from a draft of the prompt that still had two thick black cables (task 01a1c22a-06f0-75f8-8c55-898aaafedecf, 9 credits) was made and not used. Credits read from each task's consumed_credits; no queue time in any task. The FBX comparison in Step 6 comes from November 8, 2026: a text-to-3d model of the same dock converted to FBX with meshy convert (task 01a1be80-1240-7415-a513-69d7c9660a44, 1 credit) and imported by the agent with StaticMeshTools.import_file, which left Nanite off and wired the roughness map to Metallic, with nothing on Roughness and no metallic map.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; GLB JSON accessors, mesh, material, image, skin and animation arrays; primitive attributes, POSITION min and max, and the embedded JPEG headers.
artifact_inspection.note: The pictured run's GLB, saved by the agent as MeshyAssets/charging-dock.glb. It carries POSITION, NORMAL and TEXCOORD_0, one double-sided opaque material with a base color texture, a metallic-roughness texture and a normal texture, all embedded as JPEG: 4096 x 4096 base color and normal maps and a 2048 x 2048 metallic-roughness map. It measures 1.405 x 1.110 x 1.903 m (glTF X, Y up, Z) with the origin at the center of its bounds. Model files are not published by this repository.
